# Botanist
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Personnel.
2. Botanists are to fulfill the requests of other departments when possible, including but not limited to requests from the Cargo Department, the Service Department, or the Chemistry Team.
3. Botanists are not expected to deliver crops to other departments. Iit is the responsibility of the requester to pick up their order with a storage container.
4. Kudzu outbreaks are to be treated with thoroughness and haste.
5. Botanists are responsible for any harm or damages that comes as a result of their crops - this includes crop samples publicly distributed, or contents produced from biomass generators, planter trays, or soil mounds.
